noncomputable def VTask.findGreatest (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  match [Finset.range (n + 1)].filter (λ i => P i).rev with
  | []     => 0
  | (x :: _) => x.val
